ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in the circle $\odot O$. If $\angle ADC=85^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle B$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $O$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC + \angle B = 180^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle ADC = 85^\circ$,\\
then $\angle B = 180^\circ - \angle ADC$\\
$= 180^\circ - 85^\circ$\\
$= \boxed{95^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, note that ∠ADC is an inscribed angle whose sides DA and DC intercept the arc AC that passes through B, while ∠ABC is an inscribed angle whose sides BA and BC intercept the other arc AC that passes through D. From the text, take ∠ADC = 85°. By the inscribed angle theorem, the intercepted arc through B has measure 2 × 85° = 170°. The two arcs from A to C together make the full circle, so the other arc through D has measure 360° - 170° = 190°. Then ∠ABC is half of that intercepted arc, so ∠B = 190° / 2 = 95°.
